title: Certifying the ring of integers of a degree-six number field

source.citation: Alain Chavarri Villarello, RingOfIntegersProject, commit b2bfff66bb5354694df289dff1507f29a9271df2; companion data for Baanen, Chavarri Villarello, and Dahmen, Certifying rings of integers in number fields, arXiv:2409.18030

translation.notes: The defining polynomial and six-element certificate basis are translated from the Apache-2.0 repository snapshot. The solution independently asks Noether to validate the order, compute the maximal order, and prove equality; no repository code or paper prose is copied.
